title: Concept: etcd version endpoint disclosed in a response
description: The etcd version document names the server and cluster versions of a distributed key-value store. That store holds cluster state and often the credentials other services read at start-up, so an open version endpoint is a sign that the key space is open too.
applicability: Responses served by etcd on a reachable client port.
risk: Cluster configuration and stored keys are likely readable; MEDIUM severity because reachability of the version endpoint implies the client API answers.
